validation: Offline build succeeded. A disposable no-network VM with no host mounts or secrets executed the binary and received an initialize response. A second guest test ran the app-server and a synthetic MCP server, recording an uncertain attempt through a guest Unix socket relay and vsock capability to a same-UID fixture owner.
limitations: No independent second build or production image provenance has been verified. The guest lacked a verified bubblewrap installation. The grant, capability key and host owner were fixtures. Portable session export/import, host identity isolation, complete remote inventory and receiver release remain unproven.
